Export direct feature arrays with traceable Feature_ID rows.

filters.pipeline: (08) Small IN100 Grain Size Groups and Representatives.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Read the surface-selection checkpoint. Preserve source geometry, FeatureIds, measurements, and masks.

filters.pipeline: (08) Small IN100 Grain Size Groups and Representatives.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Partition selected scalar diameters in micrometers into three illustrative groups using arithmetic means. Group IDs 1..3 are unordered; excluded rows have ID 0. Ignore reserved center row 0.

filters.pipeline: (08) Small IN100 Grain Size Groups and Representatives.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Compare three groups from the same selected diameters using observed representative sizes and scalar Euclidean distance. Representatives are diameter values, not unique grain IDs; ignore reserved row 0.

filters.pipeline: (08) Small IN100 Grain Size Groups and Representatives.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Export all positive original feature rows with both masks and group IDs; retain excluded and unused rows for traceability.

filters.pipeline: (08) Small IN100 Grain Size Groups and Representatives.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Export only group rows 1..3 with their arithmetic mean diameters in micrometers; Feature_ID identifies the K-means group.

filters.pipeline: (08) Small IN100 Grain Size Groups and Representatives.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Export only group rows 1..3 with observed representative diameters in micrometers; Feature_ID identifies the K-medoids group.

filters.pipeline: (08) Small IN100 Grain Size Groups and Representatives.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Save all source data plus both group assignments, center tables, and stored seeds. Exclude row 0 from group interpretation.
